package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type fixedCourseCompletion struct {
	completed map[string]struct{}
}

func (stub fixedCourseCompletion) GetCompletedLessonIDs(context.Context, string, []string) (map[string]struct{}, error) {
	result := make(map[string]struct{}, len(stub.completed))
	for lessonID := range stub.completed {
		result[lessonID] = struct{}{}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func TestPartAccessUsesCurrentMilestoneInsteadOfFuturePrerequisites(t *testing.T) {
	current := &partRuntimeContext{studentPracticeTask: &domain.StudentPracticeTask{}}
	milestones := []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone{
		{
			ID:     "html",
			Status: domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable,
			Prerequisites: domain.MilestonePrerequisites{
				MatchedLessonIDs:   []string{"lesson-html"},
				CompletedLessonIDs: []string{"lesson-html"},
				UsesExplicitRoute:  true,
			},
		},
		{
			ID:             "css",
			Status:         domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked,
			BlockingReason: blockingReasonMilestonePrerequisites,
			Prerequisites: domain.MilestonePrerequisites{
				MatchedLessonIDs:  []string{"lesson-css"},
				UnmetLessonIDs:    []string{"lesson-css"},
				UsesExplicitRoute: true,
			},
		},
	}

	access := buildPartAccess(current, milestones, derivePartStatus(milestones))
	if access.Locked {
		t.Fatalf("future CSS prerequisites must not block the current HTML milestone: %#v", access)
	}
	if len(access.Prerequisites.CompletedLessonIDs) != 1 || access.Prerequisites.CompletedLessonIDs[0] != "lesson-html" {
		t.Fatalf("part access must describe the current milestone prerequisites: %#v", access.Prerequisites)
	}
	if status := derivePartStatus(milestones); status != domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable {
		t.Fatalf("part with an available current milestone must be available, got %s", status)
	}
}

func TestPartRuntimeSnapshotContainsOnlyCurrentMilestone(t *testing.T) {
	contract := domain.ValidationContract{
		Version: 1,
		Kind:    "workspace_contract",
		Stages:  []domain.ValidationStage{{ID: "html", Engine: "html.dom"}},
	}
	current := partRuntimeContext{
		studentPracticeTask: &domain.StudentPracticeTask{WorkspaceTaskID: "workspace-task", WorkspaceLessonID: "workspace-lesson"},
		runtimeContext:      &domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{PracticeTask: domain.PracticeTask{ID: "practice-task"}},
		part:                &domain.PracticeTaskPart{ID: "catalog", Title: "Catalog"},
		partMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
			{ID: "html", IsActive: true},
			{ID: "css", IsActive: true},
		},
		studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID: map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{
			"html": {ID: "student-html", PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: "html"},
			"css":  {ID: "student-css", PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: "css"},
		},
		build: &PartBuildPreview{
			Milestones: []MilestoneBuildPreview{{
				Milestone: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
					ID:                 "html",
					Title:              "HTML catalog",
					LearningTargets:    []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "web.catalog.render-products", Version: "v1"}},
					RuntimeProfileJSON: json.RawMessage(`{"code_structure_type_code":"HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT","compose_config":{"version":"3.9","services":{}}}`),
				},
				Contract: contract,
			}},
			Contract: contract,
		},
	}

	snapshot, err := buildRuntimeTaskSnapshotFromPart(current, domain.MilestoneAccess{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build current milestone snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	if len(snapshot.PartMilestoneIDs) != 1 || snapshot.PartMilestoneIDs[0] != "html" || len(snapshot.StudentMilestoneIDs) != 1 || snapshot.StudentMilestoneIDs[0] != "student-html" {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot must bind only the current milestone: %#v", snapshot)
	}
	if len(snapshot.LearningTargets) != 1 || snapshot.LearningTargets[0].Key != "web.catalog.render-products" {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot must project only the current milestone targets: %#v", snapshot.LearningTargets)
	}
}

func TestLaterRouteMilestoneIsBlockedUntilPreviousMilestonePasses(t *testing.T) {
	previous := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		ID: "html", PartSortOrder: 10, SortOrder: 10, IsActive: true,
		LessonBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{{LessonID: "lesson-html"}},
	}
	currentMilestone := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{ID: "javascript", PartSortOrder: 20, SortOrder: 20, IsActive: true}
	current := &partRuntimeContext{
		runtimeContext: &domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{previous, currentMilestone}},
		part:           &domain.PracticeTaskPart{},
		studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID: map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{
			"html":       {ID: "student-html", Status: domain.StudentMilestoneStatusNotStarted},
			"javascript": {ID: "student-javascript", Status: domain.StudentMilestoneStatusNotStarted},
		},
	}

	if block := practiceTaskMilestoneLessonBlock(current, currentMilestone, domain.MilestonePrerequisites{}); block != blockingReasonPreviousMilestone {
		t.Fatalf("later route milestone must wait for the previous milestone, got %q", block)
	}
	if redirect := practiceTaskMilestoneLessonRedirect(current, currentMilestone, blockingReasonPreviousMilestone); redirect != "lesson-html" {
		t.Fatalf("later route must redirect to the blocking milestone lesson, got %q", redirect)
	}
}

func TestRoadmapUsesExplicitLessonBindingsForLockedStatus(t *testing.T) {
	milestone := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		ID:        "html",
		IsActive:  true,
		SortOrder: 10,
		LessonBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{{
			LessonID: "lesson-html", Requirement: domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired,
		}},
	}
	studentMilestone := domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{
		ID: "student-html", PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: "html", Status: domain.StudentMilestoneStatusNotStarted,
	}
	useCase := StudentUseCase{Completion: fixedCourseCompletion{completed: map[string]struct{}{}}}

	statuses, _, err := useCase.resolveRoadmapStatuses(
		context.Background(),
		&domain.StudentPracticeTask{StudentID: "student"},
		[]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{milestone},
		[]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{studentMilestone},
		nil,
		nil,
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve roadmap statuses: %v", err)
	}
	if statuses[milestone.ID] != domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked {
		t.Fatalf("required explicit lesson must lock roadmap milestone, got %#v", statuses)
	}
}

func TestSplitPartValidationResultReadsValidationReportEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
	raw := json.RawMessage(`{
		"source":"validation_orchestrator",
		"validation_report":{
			"contract_kind":"workspace_contract",
			"contract_version":1,
			"passed":true,
			"stages":[{
				"stage_id":"runtime-html::html-structure",
				"engine":"html.dom",
				"status":"passed",
				"passed":true,
				"optional":false
			}]
		}
	}`)

	results, rawByMilestone, err := splitPartValidationResult(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("split enveloped validation report: %v", err)
	}
	result, ok := results["runtime-html"]
	if !ok || !result.Passed || len(result.Stages) != 1 || result.Stages[0].StageID != "html-structure" {
		t.Fatalf("enveloped report was not assigned to its milestone: %#v", results)
	}
	if len(rawByMilestone["runtime-html"]) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("normalized milestone evidence was not retained: %#v", rawByMilestone)
	}
}
